overall_goal: Add coconut milk to the blender, then pour and enjoy the mango lassi.

goals.description: Retrieve ingredients and inspect the blender.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves coconut milk and honey from the cupboard and inspects them along with the blender.

goals.description: Open and stir the tin of coconut milk.
goals.rationale: The person uses a can opener and a tablespoon to open, inspect, and stir the tin of coconut milk.

goals.description: Measure and pour coconut milk into the blender.
goals.rationale: The person pours coconut milk into a measuring cup, confirms the quantity, stirs it, and adds it to the blender.

goals.description: Prepare a tumbler and pour mango lassi from the blender.
goals.rationale: The person gets a tumbler, removes the blender lid, and pours mango lassi into the tumbler.

goals.description: Drink the mango lassi and refill the tumbler.
goals.rationale: The person drinks from the tumbler and pours more mango lassi into it.

goals.description: Prepare a keep cup and pour mango lassi into the cups.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a keep cup and pours mango lassi into both the keep cup and the tumbler.

goals.description: Drink the mango lassi and refill the tumbler again.
goals.rationale: The person drinks more mango lassi, refills the tumbler, and inspects the remaining contents of the blender cup.
